tool_input.command:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(makefile): close shell-script-discovery filename injection (FIX 1)

git ls-files --others --exclude-standard picks up untracked files, so a
crafted filename in the working tree (e.g. containing a double quote)
could break out of xargs -I{}'s sh -c script text and execute arbitrary
shell during `make check` or `make lint-shell`. Filenames now arrive at
the inner shell as genuine argv elements ("$@"), never spliced into the
script text itself.

test-shell-discovery is a new make target, wired into lint-shell, that
reproduces the exact crafted-filename attack in an isolated temp repo and
asserts discovery does not execute it -- both the discovery pipeline and
the regression test share one DISCOVER_SHELL_SCRIPTS definition so a
future edit to one cannot silently drift from the other.

beadle-qtei
EOF
)"
